questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct form of the verb in brackets: By the time I arrived, the meeting (already start).
Which sentence correctly reports the statement: 'I have finished my homework.'?
options: He said he finished his homework.
He said he had finished his homework.
He said he was finishing his homework.
He said he would finish his homework.
questions.answer: He said he had finished his homework.

He said if he knew, he would have helped.
He said if he knew, he would help.

Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the information? 'The company announced that the new product would be launched next month.'
options: It was announced that the new product would be launched next month.
It was announced that the new product would launch next month.
It announced that the new product would be launched next month.
It announces that the new product would be launched next month.
questions.answer: It was announced that the new product would be launched next month.
